The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] known as the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]] owned a '''''D5-Mantis'' Patrol Craft''' that the hunter's crew used to travel [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]]<ref name="Joy Ride" /> and beyond.
